summary: Imperative equivalents exist for gestures, shortcuts, focus, clipboard, drag and drop, and an AT-SPI accessibility bridge. Custom rotors and the display accommodation flags (reduce motion, increase contrast) now exist for apps (sdk/src/accessibility_rotor.rs, sdk/src/accessibility_display.rs). There is no declarative modifier API, no app-facing announcement call, and no Xcode tooling.

features.feature: Gestures (tap, drag, magnify, rotate, long press)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 10 tests. recognizer models, but no composable modifier API (simultaneous/sequenced)

features.feature: Input events (keyboard shortcuts, hover, key press)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. shortcuts and responder chain exist; no Touch Bar (n/a)

Named boards, types, change counts and per-type data are tested headless (headless_clipboard_* in sdk/tests), and a Transferable value is written as all its representations in one step. The enablement rules of the edit commands (cut, copy, paste, select all, delete) are tested in parity_sdk-complete-27.rs. Gap: text controls do not yet route their menu items through EditCommand, which needs the shell's menus and a text field on Midget.
drag sources and destinations with typed items
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 11 tests. focus ring model; no focused-value scene propagation

Workspace event names and content-type icons are tested headless (headless_system_events_* in sdk/tests). The Activity record (a dotted type, carried state, current or resigned, continuation and search eligibility) is tested in parity_sdk-complete-27.rs. Gap: the shell does not yet carry an Activity to another window or device, and no handoff from a URL is wired.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/ax.rs (Map, Announcements, role_name, Priority); tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01b.rs; springboard/src/shell/atspi/mod.rs; springboard/sdk/src/view/mod.rs
features.note: Element map, role names, priorities and the announcement queue are tested headless (headless_accessibility_* in ui/tests). AT-SPI2 bridge with hierarchy and state; shell chrome not in tree; untested on live Orca (docs/bifrost-ui.md)

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 6 tests. Wave 4 (theme-02, parity/integration 0925691e): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. light/dark exist; no reduce-motion or contrast environment flags found
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 25 tests. press, set value, focus only; no custom actions
verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 25 tests. label and value; no label/title/help split or announcements

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 2 (theme-31, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. documented as no rotor equivalent
no AppKit in BifrOSt; one native view layer

features.feature: Technology-specific views (Map, Quick Look, web, share)
features.note: share, web view and Quick Look exist. The map camera, zoom and coordinate model is in springboard/ui/src/mapview.rs and geo.rs, but no SDK map view wraps it yet; tile fetching lives in the maps app (apps/maps-desktop/src/tiles.rs), not in the SDK.

features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/testing.rs (TestWindow: offscreen render and element queries)
features.note: A view renders headless into a pixel buffer, tested in springboard/sdk/tests/parity_sdk-tests-09.rs (a_headless_preview_renders_the_view_into_a_pixel_buffer_of_the_window_size, the_offscreen_render_of_a_button_differs_from_an_empty_window). Host previews are bifrost pc smoke and gallery; there is no live preview in an IDE.

features.feature: Xcode library customization and performance analysis

gaps: Live-region announcements and custom actions reach the model only: bifrost_ui::ax has Announcements and add_custom_action (tests ax::tests), and custom rotors are in sdk/src/accessibility_rotor.rs (tests in ui/src/ax_rotor.rs); no SDK call posts an announcement.
